title: 2008 HMMT November Guts Problem 12
statement:
Solve the following system of equations for \(w\).

\[\begin{aligned}
& 2 w+x+y+z=1 \\
& w+2 x+y+z=2 \\
& w+x+2 y+z=2 \\
& w+x+y+2 z=1
\end{aligned}\]

solutions.text: \(\quad \frac{-1}{5}\) Add all the equations together to find that \(5 x+5 y+5 z+5 w=6\), or \(x+y+z+w=\frac{6}{5}\). We can now subtract this equation from the first equation to see that \(w=\frac{-1}{5}\).
